select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID feeId, FIN_PRODUCT.p_Finprod_Id finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID sfinprodId, DATE_FORMAT(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH) branch, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE calcStartDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE calcEndDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CLEAN isClean, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT actPayAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_AMT payAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT adjustAmt from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL, FIN_PRODUCT, TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL, MST_FEEINFO, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID=PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT PAY_CYCLE FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId} and eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') LIMIT 1

select FIN_PRODUCT.CCY as ccy , FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE as dealMode, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE, mdate from FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD
where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId}
LIMIT 1

select dat.resiPrincipal from ( select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_CASH_POSITION psp
where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and psp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_CASH_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) order by psp.CDATE desc )dat where LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN inner JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE = #{chargeType_01} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= str_to_date(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d') and (CASE WHEN MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE = #{feeType_03, jdbcType = VARCHAR} THEN 0 WHEN #{feeType_04, jdbcType = VARCHAR} THEN 0 WHEN #{feeType_12, jdbcType = VARCHAR} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) =1
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.Mdate = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C11} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})

select IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(fee_amt, 0)), 0) from trd_trade_fee_detail where fee_type = #{feeType1} and trade_id in (select deal.trade_id from trd_product_deal deal, trd_product_deal_add add1, fin_product prod, fin_deal_pledge ple where prod.finprod_type2 in ('F01', 'F02', 'F03', 'F04', 'F05') and is_cancel = 'N' and add1.trade_id = deal.trade_id and add1.portfolio_id = #{ptlId} and deal.trade_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and prod.finprod_id = ple.pledge_finprod_id and ple.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id and prod.REGIST_ORG = #{org})
